# graphiant_site_list (Data Source)

Looks up a single Graphiant global site list by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_site_list" "west_coast" {
  id = 12345
}

output "west_coast_member_count" {
  value = length(data.graphiant_site_list.west_coast.entries)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Site list identifier.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339, UTC).
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the site list.
- `edge_references` (Number) Number of edge devices referencing this site list.
- `entries` (Attributes List) Members of this site list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `name` (String) Site list name.
- `policy_references` (Number) Number of policies referencing this site list.
- `site_list_references` (Number) Number of other site lists referencing this site list.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `site_id` (Number)
- `tag` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries--tag))

<a id="nestedatt--entries--tag"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.tag`

Read-Only:

- `level_one` (Number)
- `level_two` (Number)
- `level_zero` (Number)
